drafts.title: A Story of Kindness, Courage, and Belonging.
drafts.body:
Jordan is a cautious but gentle dog who has survived life on the streets. When he enters the care of the Foster family, he struggles to trust others and feel that he belongs. Fiona, the family’s wise older dog, helps Jordan discover friendship, courage, and the safety of opening his heart.

This illustrated read-aloud is intended for children ages 3–8 and gives parents and caregivers a warm way to discuss kindness, patience, trust, and belonging.

Jordan and the Fosters is available in paperback, hardcover, and digital editions.

"Joe Dinicola tells a tale that would likely inspire a child and parent to explore ways to express care for others."
- Constance Stadler, Readers’ Favorite
